# Sound credits

Three samples from **Impact Sounds** by **Kenney**, licensed **Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal** (public domain).

Original pack and license declaration: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
CC0 legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Download mirror: https://github.com/GeorgeQLe/assets-sfx-combat/tree/main/assets/kenney/impact-sounds/Audio

| Local filename | Original filename        | Use                 |
| -------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------- |
| step.ogg       | footstep_grass_000.ogg   | Walking foley       |
| pull.ogg       | footstep_grass_003.ogg   | Grass-pulling layer |
| pickup.ogg     | impactBell_heavy_000.ogg | Discovery accent    |

Playback pitch and volume vary in the game. These samples are layered with original procedural Web Audio rustle, wind, birds, bus engine, tool creaks, and musical cues. The bus is synthesized, not a field recording. All audio is served locally; there are no runtime external asset requests.

Clippers use an original procedural two-transient snip generated in `src/systems/audio.js`. The former metallic impact sample has been removed. The flower incident uses original filtered noise and detuned low tones.
